name: Hidizs
_refused: Read 2026-11-25 and refused. The prohibiting clause: « You agree not to reproduce, duplicate, copy, sell, resell or exploit any portion of the Service, use of the Service, or access to the Service or any contact on the website through which the service is provided, without express written permission by us. » And a second, independently sufficient one: « you are prohibited from using the site or its content: (a) for any unlawful purpose; [...] (i) to spam, phish, pharm, pretext, spider, crawl, or scrape » The terms claim the whole site, not a shop: « This website is operated by Hidizs . Throughout the site, the terms "we", "us" and "our" refer to Hidizs . [...] These Terms of Service apply to all users of the site, including without limitation users who are browsers, vendors, customers, merchants, and/ or contributors of content. » Its product pages are at www.hidizs.net/products/… - the SAME host that serves these terms, since the site is a Shopify storefront. So the scope question that saved Shanling does not arise: there is no separate specification host to fall back on, and the preamble binds « users who are browsers » expressly. Footer: « (c) 2026, HIDIZS | Soulful Music Beyond Time and Space. » robots.txt carries no Content-Signal and names no Claude agent at all - stock Shopify, « Allow: / » with cart and account paths disallowed, which grants nothing that could override the clause. No product page was opened and no record will exist under this brand.
_it_can_be_lifted: Both clauses are conditioned on written permission - « without express written permission by us » for Hidizs, « without our written permission » for EarMen. So this is a permission request, not a dead end, and the brand belongs on the letter list rather than among the permanent gaps. What is lost meanwhile: for EarMen, the per-input ceilings of the Tradutto, Angel and CH-Amp, which are desktop units with real optical, coaxial and Bluetooth inputs; for Hidizs, a range of dongles and players that state DSD transports more often than most.
